topic: Franky's bet and Sogeking's keys freed Robin's Seastone cuffs at Enies Lobby
title: Robin's Cuffs Were Real, But She Wasn't Alone
description: Robin's Seastone cuffs were real, and Spandam had her. But Franky burned the Pluton blueprints, Sogeking stopped Spandam, and the keys came off. Here's why that rescue says more about Robin than the Navy's cage does.
comment: Was the Enies Lobby rescue the crew's win, or proof Robin was never really stuck? Pick one.

lines.text: Robin's Seastone cuffs were real, and that's the part everyone forgets.

lines.text: He stopped Spandam with his Kabuto and saved Robin.
The keys Sogeking threw freed her from those cuffs.
Spandam had her, and he still lost the cage.
